rules.statement: A deed of gift does not create a fidei commissum in favor of the children if it only conveys property to a descendant with a condition that if they die issueless, the property is to vest in a third party.
rules.supporting_quote: "The mere fact that an ascendant by his instrument (we use the neutral word instrument to include both last wills and deeds inter vivos) conveys property to a descendant B upon condition that if B dies issueless the property is to vest in C does not imply a fidei commissum. in favour of B's issue in the event of B dying leaving issue."
